sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa: Get Information / Do I need visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.e-gov.kg service identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and requires selection of country, travel-document type and visa type for eligibility information.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Choose your Country, Type of Travel Document and Visa Type.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa country visa-regime selector backend
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: This same-origin endpoint serves the separate Do I Need Visa regime display; it is not the application eligibility gate and cannot support an omitted-country inference.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa application eligibility gate
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The official application form calls same-origin getList7 after passport-country selection, then passes country and document type to getVisaList_2. Fresh-session replays for AF, DZ, AO, AG, BS, BD, BB, BZ, BJ and BT failed at host connection before any gate response; Kosovo and Taiwan are absent from the country selector.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa official portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official portal identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as operator and describes online eVisa issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronic visa grants the same right to enter Kyrgyzstan as an ordinary sticker visa.

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers regulation on entry and stay of foreign citizens
sources.publisher: Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Cabinet legal-acts portal publishes the foreign-citizen entry and stay regulation; it requires a visa unless a treaty or legal act establishes otherwise.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign citizens enter the Kyrgyz Republic with an entry visa, unless otherwise provided.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Export: current visa-free regime list
sources.publisher: Export Promotion and Investment Agency of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The official government service publishes a positive current visa-free list and says it reflects the latest legislative amendments.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of 71 countries have the opportunity to visit Kyrgyzstan without obtaining a visa.
